entity_types: Non-profit associations (3+ founders, foreigners OK); foundations; NPOs registered under Law 80/2021 via the National Registration Center; public-benefit status available.
cost_time: About USD 300-550 including notary and legal fees; registration takes 2-8 weeks. Foreign founders permitted; the electronic register accepts documents by post or courier.

entity_types: Public associations (3+ founders); foundations; registered under the 2020 Law on Non-commercial Organisations. Foreigners may found with local involvement.
cost_time: No state registration fee (2020 NCO law); about EUR 100-300 for notary and legal support only. Processing 2-6 weeks; no official processing time published.

entity_types: Non-profit legal entities (NPL) under the Non-Profit Legal Entities Act; associations; foundations; registered at the Agency for Registration. A 1-founder NPL is the simplest route.
cost_time: About BGN 150-300 plus notary fees; statutory 30 days. Foreigners can found an NPL; no residency requirement for the founding act itself.

entity_types: Associations (min 7 founders, Law 1566/1985); foundations (Law 40/2022); general-benefit status via separate application after court-registry filing.
cost_time: About EUR 500-1500 in notary and legal fees; 1-3 months. Foreigners may be founders; general-benefit status is a separate, discretionary step.

entity_types: Companies limited by guarantee (most charities); incorporated associations; registered with the CRO and then with the Charities Regulatory Authority (CRA).
cost_time: CRO incorporation about EUR 100; charity registration with the CRA is free; 4-8 weeks. Foreign directors permitted if residency rules are met.

entity_types: Associations (felag, 2+ members); foundations (stifting, Act 33/1999); both registered with the Registrator (RSK) under the Directorate of Internal Revenue.
cost_time: Association registration about ISK 5,000-10,000; 2-4 weeks. Foundations require a minimum endowment of about ISK 1,000,000; foreigners may found.

entity_types: Member associations (lag, Act 2020); foundations; both registered with the Brønnøysund Register. No minimum capital; a simple notification regime.
cost_time: Association registration at Brønnøysund is FREE; 2-6 weeks. Foreigners may be members and board; no local residency required for registration.

entity_types: Associations (yhdistys, 5+ members); foundations (säätiö); registered with PRH (Patent and Registration Office). Charitable status via the Tax Administration.
cost_time: PRH registration fee about EUR 100; 1-3 months. Foreigners may be members; no residency requirement to found an association.

entity_types: Economic associations (ekonomiska föreningar); ideal associations; foundations; registered with Bolagsverket (Swedish Companies Registration Office).
cost_time: About SEK 1,000-2,500; 4-8 weeks. A bank account needs a D-number. Foreigners may be members; no residency rule for founding.

entity_types: Voluntary associations (frivillige foreninger); foundations; associations registered with the CVR register. The 2023 Foundation Act applies to foundations.
cost_time: Association registration at CVR is free; DKK 0-2,000 total with legal support; 2-6 weeks. The 2023 Foundation Act requires a Danish-resident board majority.

entity_types: Non-governmental organisations (NVO); associations; foundations; registered in the Enterprise Register under the 2016 NVO law via the e-portal.
cost_time: State fee about EUR 11-12; total EUR 30-100; 1-4 weeks. The 2016 NVO law removed the notary step. A Latvian-resident board and local address are required.

entity_types: Associations (7+ members, Law of Associations 5725-1965); societies; companies limited by guarantee; registered with the Registrar of Associations.
cost_time: About USD 150-350 in fees plus USD 500-2000 attorney; 2-6 weeks. A registered Israeli office (lease of 1+ yr) is required; citizenship is not needed.

entity_types: Associations under Law 92/1909 (notification/declaration regime); foundations. Ordinary associations operate on a declaration basis, not full registration.
cost_time: About USD 100-500; 2-6 weeks. Foreigners may found and direct associations; the notification regime is less formal than a full registration system.

entity_types: Non-governmental organisations under Law 12 of 2010; registered with the NGO Directorate of the Interior Ministry. Associations are the main registered form.
cost_time: Fees low, but registration is effectively barred to foreigners: Law 12/2010 requires at least 10 Iraqi-national/resident founders. Official processing times unpublished.

entity_types: Civil (NGO) organisations under Law 19 of 2006; registered with the Ministry of Social Development (NGO Support Department).
cost_time: Registration is effectively out of reach for foreigners: Law 19/2006 requires 20 Bahraini founders and a 2/3 Bahraini board. Official processing time unpublished.

entity_types: Voluntary and humanitarian organisations under the 2006 Voluntary & Humanitarian Work (Organisation) Act; associations are the main registered form.
cost_time: Registration is suspended and unworkable since the 2023 civil war; the 2006 Act makes registration mandatory and the state a gatekeeper. Effectively impossible now.

entity_types: Non-governmental organisations under NGO Law No. 19 of 2001 (plus 2013 circulars); scope limited to social, cultural, sports, charitable and humanitarian work.
cost_time: No path to foreign formation; dual authorities and state-gatekept registration. Effectively impossible for a foreign founder with no local presence.

entity_types: Associations under Law 12-06 of 2012 (amended 2020); associations for utility (d'intérêt général); registered with the wilaya (province) authorities.
cost_time: About DZD 5,000-15,000; 1-3 months. Foreign-founded associations require government pre-approval (art.23); a 2025 replacement bill is not in force.
